'''Justicar territory''', also known as the '''Justicars' Sector''' or '''sector 439''', was an area of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|lower levels]] that was ruled by the [[Justicars' Brigade|Justicars]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In the aftermath of the [[Sacking of Coruscant]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] resources were severely limited and [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Forces]] were pulled from the area. In the ensuing chaos, gangs such as [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] moved in preying on the helpless [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]]. Angered by returning to homes and communities under siege, ex-[[Republic soldier]]s formed their own [[Militia/Legends|militia]] calling themselves the Justicars' Brigade.<ref name="SWTORJusticarcodex" /> A former Coruscant Security facility was utilized as their headquarters and renamed the "[[Justicars' Tower]]."<ref name="SWTOREG" /> The Justicars placed the sector under martial law and pushed out both Black Sun and Coruscant Security. Any challenge to their authority was brutally struck down and the sector was practically closed off from the outside world.<ref name="SWTORwhitenoise">{{TORcite|type=general|White Noise|Coruscant}}</ref>
